parameters.content:
## CG · 03 Batch Runner
Bulk generation for many topics.

`POST /webhook/content/batch` with `{ "topics": ["...", {"topic": "...", "style": "guide"}], "defaults": {...}, "concurrency": 3 }` answers **202** at once with a `batch_id`, then runs the topics in waves of `concurrency` through the public content API, so every item gets the same validation, fallbacks, quality gate and 5-minute budget.

The summary (status counts, p50/p95 latency, cost, run ids) is written to `outputs/<batch_id>.json`; `GET /webhook/content/batch-status?batch_id=...` returns it.

nodeGroups.name: Accept batch
nodeGroups.description: Validates the topic list, writes a running manifest and answers 202 with the batch id (400 if invalid).

nodeGroups.name: Generate in waves
nodeGroups.description: Calls the content API for each topic, a wave of `concurrency` requests at a time.

nodeGroups.name: Summarize
nodeGroups.description: Builds status counts, p50/p95 latency and cost per batch and saves outputs/<batch_id>.json.

nodeGroups.name: Batch status
nodeGroups.description: Returns the saved batch file for a valid batch_id, 404 for an unknown one and 400 for a malformed one.
